name: drift-retrieval-final
provenance: Prospective human-authored synthetic projects frozen before Phase III-B retrieval experiments.

requirements.title: Policyholder login
requirements.description: Policyholders shall sign in with email and password.

requirements.title: Claim submission
requirements.description: Policyholders shall submit a claim with incident details.

requirements.title: Claim evidence
requirements.description: Policyholders shall attach images and PDF documents to a claim.

requirements.title: Claim status
requirements.description: Policyholders shall view the current processing status of a claim.

requirements.title: Adjuster assignment
requirements.description: Supervisors shall assign an adjuster to each submitted claim.

requirements.title: Claim messages
requirements.description: Policyholders and adjusters shall exchange messages within a claim.

requirements.title: Claim payout
requirements.description: Approved claim payouts shall be sent by bank transfer.

requirements.title: Policy renewal
requirements.description: Policyholders shall renew an eligible policy online.

requirements.title: Policy documents
requirements.description: Policyholders shall download policy schedules and certificates as PDF files.

requirements.title: Policy notifications
requirements.description: Policyholders shall receive email reminders before a policy expires.

queries.message: Let customers attach short incident videos along with their claim photos.
Pay an approved settlement to a digital wallet rather than only a bank account.
Text the customer two weeks before coverage ends.
A broker should monitor the progress of claims authorized by a customer.
Allow the assigned examiner and customer to exchange document attachments in their conversation.
Use passkeys instead of passwords for account access.

requirements.title: Operator authentication
requirements.description: Operators shall sign in with a badge and PIN.

requirements.title: Work orders
requirements.description: Planners shall create and schedule production work orders.

requirements.title: Work order approval
requirements.description: Supervisors shall approve a work order before production starts.

requirements.title: Material allocation
requirements.description: Warehouse staff shall allocate available material to a work order.

requirements.title: Machine assignment
requirements.description: Planners shall assign an available machine to a work order.

requirements.title: Quality inspection
requirements.description: Inspectors shall record pass or reject results for manufactured units.

requirements.title: Defect records
requirements.description: Inspectors shall record a defect category and reason for every rejected unit.

requirements.title: Preventive maintenance
requirements.description: Technicians shall schedule maintenance using machine operating hours.

requirements.title: Emergency stop events
requirements.description: The system shall record every emergency stop activation.

requirements.title: Production output
requirements.description: Operators shall record completed quantities against a work order.

requirements.title: Scrap tracking
requirements.description: Operators shall record scrapped quantity and material reason.

requirements.title: Shift handover
requirements.description: Outgoing operators shall leave handover notes for the next shift.

requirements.title: Production report
requirements.description: Managers shall export daily production totals as CSV files.

requirements.title: Plant dashboard
requirements.description: Managers shall view live machine state and production progress.

requirements.title: Downtime alerts
requirements.description: Supervisors shall receive email alerts when a machine stops unexpectedly.

requirements.title: Manufacturing audit log
requirements.description: Administrators shall review configuration and approval events for one year.

queries.message: Notify the shift lead in Microsoft Teams whenever equipment goes down without warning.
Base service intervals on both runtime hours and completed cycles.
Show energy consumption beside live machine status on the plant overview.
A rejection cannot be saved without its fault classification and explanation.
Include night-shift totals in the downloadable daily spreadsheet.
Require the quality lead to sign off before a production job may begin.
